
prefix-set pl150-deny
end-set

prefix-set pl150-permit
  10.1.0.0/16,
  10.10.0.0/15 ge 16 le 16,
  10.10.1.0/24,
  10.12.0.0/16
end-set

!
route-policy MyMap_2_1
if destination in pl150-permit and not destination in pl150-deny then
 set med 10
 set community (1:200) additive
 done
endif
end-policy
!
router bgp 1
!
 neighbor 10.0.0.2
 remote-as 2
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   route-policy MyMap_2_1 out
exit

Warning: filter matches ANY/NOT ANY:MyMap_3_2

!
route-policy MyMap_3_2
 drop
done
end-policy
!
router bgp 1
!
 neighbor 10.0.0.3
 remote-as 3
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   route-policy MyMap_3_2 out
exit

prefix-set pl151-deny
end-set

prefix-set pl151-permit
  10.1.0.0/16
end-set

!
route-policy MyMap_5_3
if destination in pl151-permit and not destination in pl151-deny then
  prepend as-path 1 3
 done
endif
end-policy
!
router bgp 1
!
 neighbor 10.0.0.5
 remote-as 5
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   route-policy MyMap_5_3 out
exit
